members.name: Lisis Zuniga
members.role: Founder, Clinical Coordinator & Heart of the project
members.bio: More than fifteen years alongside families, patients and professionals — at home, in hospital, in the most delicate moments. Lisis founded Dedicare Solutions to bring back what healthcare risks losing: the person. She personally selects every professional, oversees every care plan and ensures every intervention is supported by clinical expertise, genuine listening and steady human presence. Her signature is in every detail: from the first free phone call to the follow-up weeks into the care journey.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.intro: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Write to us directly — we'll reply within a few hours.

items.a: We assist seniors, adults after hospitalisation, children and people with physical or cognitive disabilities who need healthcare or social-care support at home, in hospital or during transfers across the Milan metropolitan area.

items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes, completely. A no-obligation phone or WhatsApp call to understand your needs, answer your questions and propose the best solution. Call or write to us at +39 388 253 6992.

items.q: Are your staff qualified and insured?
items.a: Absolutely. Every professional — nurses, OSS, assistants — is rigorously selected, holds the qualifications required by Italian law, is covered by professional insurance and undergoes ongoing training.

items.q: Do you operate only in Milan or also in nearby areas?
items.a: We cover the entire Milan metropolitan area: Segrate, Pioltello, Sesto San Giovanni, Cologno Monzese, Vimodrone and surrounding municipalities. Contact us to verify coverage in your area.

items.q: How does night-time and weekend care work?
items.a: We are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, holidays included. Continuous on-call is not an add-on: it's a core part of our service because clinical needs don't follow a schedule.

items.q: What does the free vital signs check include?
items.a: At every visit, our staff measures blood pressure, oxygen saturation and heart rate at no cost. Values are recorded and communicated to the family, contributing to ongoing preventive monitoring.

items.q: Are home care expenses tax-deductible in Italy?
items.a: Yes. In Italy, expenses for nursing assistance and for carers of non-self-sufficient persons are deductible at 19% on your income tax return (art. 15 TUIR). Some services are also VAT-exempt. We provide all the documentation you need — correctly itemised invoices and certifications — to make the deduction straightforward.

items.q: How quickly can I activate the service?
items.a: Contact us at +39 388 253 6992 or email info@dedicaresolutions.it. After the free initial call, we can activate the service very quickly — often within 24-48 hours of the assessment.
